hub.title: Ngaahi hū mai & Sync
hub.description: Fakahū mai ʻa e tohi fakahinohino ʻo e uōtí mo e ngaahi lekooti ʻo e uiuiʻí mei he LCR ki he The Stand ʻo fakaʻaongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi faile fakaʻofisiale ʻoku ʻave ki tuʻapuleʻangá pe ko e browser DOM extractor.
hub.membersDescription: Fakahū mai ʻa e Lisi ʻo e Mēmipa ʻo e uōtí mei he LCR (hingoa, ʻīmeili, telefoni, taʻu motuʻa).
hub.viewMembers: Vakai ki he kau memipa & Notes
hub.callingsDescription: Fakahū mai ʻa e lipooti ʻa e Kau Mēmipa ʻoku ʻi ai ʻenau Ngaahi Uiuiʻí mei he LCR (ngaahi kautaha, ngaahi uiuiʻi, ngaahi ʻaho poupouʻi, ngaahi tuʻunga vahevahe).

planner.title: Fakahū mai ʻa e Ngaahi Polokalama Fakahisitōliá
planner.description: ʻOmi ʻa e ngaahi fakataha kuo ʻosi fakakakató mei he Palani Sākalamēniti ʻo e Paʻake Tauʻatāiná ki he The Stand ke lipooti.
planner.uploadDescription: Upload 'a e faile Palani Sakalameniti.html kuo 'osi 'ave ki tu'apule'anga mei ho'o ZIP. Ko e ngaahi ʻaho pē ʻo aʻu ki he ʻaho 30 ʻo ʻAokosi, 2026 ʻoku kau ki aí; ‘oku ‘ikai ke tokanga‘i ‘a e ngaahi kōlomu palani ki he kaha‘ú.

extractor.title: Browser DOM Extractor (ʻOku ʻikai ha vahevahe ʻo e lea fufuu)
extractor.description: Toʻo fakahangatonu ʻa e ngaahi fakamatalá mei hoʻo fakataha faka-Siasi kuo fakamoʻoní ʻo ʻikai vahevahe ha ngaahi fakamoʻoni pe fakatupu ha ngaahi loka maluʻi.
extractor.step1: To'o 'a e bookmark ko 'eni ki ho'o pa faka'ilonga tohi 'o e browser:
extractor.dragAlert: To'o 'a e button ko 'eni ki ho'o pa faka'ilonga tohi 'o e browser! Pea fakaava leva ʻa e LCR pea lomiʻi ia ʻi hoʻo ngaahi fakaʻilonga tohí.
extractor.andLogin: pea hū ki loto ʻaki hoʻo ʻAkauni Siasí.
extractor.step3: Lomiʻi ʻi he fakaʻilonga tohi ʻo e Ko e Tuʻu: Toʻo ʻa e LCR ʻi hoʻo paʻanga fakaʻilonga tohí.
extractor.step4: Foki heni, lomiʻi ʻi he Fakapipiki ʻa e tohí, pea fakapipiki ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻi he palakipoé ki he puhá.
extractor.copied: Ko e Kouti Fakafiemalie kuo kape!
extractor.blocked: Kapau 'oku poloka 'a e ngaahi faka'ilonga tohi 'i ho'o browser, fakapipiki 'eni ki he DevTools Console .
extractor.clipboardError: 'Oku 'ikai ke ma'u 'a e palakipoe — fakaava 'a e DevTools Console pea fakapipiki 'aki 'a e nima.
